candidates.name: CoverageJSON Standard
verified_facts: CoverageJSON is a JSON format for publishing spatiotemporal coverage data on the Web.
It can encode gridded or non-gridded coverages and continuous or categorical values.
semantic_limits: Encoding values as CoverageJSON does not establish sensor accuracy, raster lineage, survey date or parcel-specific validity; the payload inherits those properties from its source.

candidates.name: Geography Markup Language (GML) Standard
verified_facts: GML is an XML grammar for expressing and exchanging geographic features and their spatial and non-spatial properties.
Application schemas can define domain-specific feature structures.
semantic_limits: GML structure or schema validity does not certify exact HMLR legal boundaries, coordinate precision, or terrain elevation accuracy.
